presence_lines.marker: Rook keeps one eye on the door.
presence_lines.made: Rook nods. The back room is open.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Rook waits where the road goes dark.

presence_lines.marker: Switch watches both ends of the road.
presence_lines.associate: Switch has tonight's route in her head.
presence_lines.made: Switch knows where the sweep turns next.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Switch is already three roads ahead.

members.rook_line: Switch works the truck stops. Listen where the engines idle.

presence_lines.associate: Mags has every loose piece sorted.
presence_lines.made: Mags has a plan and no patience for edits.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Mags has already measured the exit.

members.rook_line: Mags buys what the rain brings. Find the quiet market.

presence_lines.marker: Knuckles watches the room make mistakes.
presence_lines.associate: Knuckles keeps a clean corner for hot goods.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Knuckles waits. Nobody tests the wait.

members.rook_line: Knuckles follows the fights. Look for the room picking sides.

presence_lines.marker: Velvet makes the worn room feel invited.
presence_lines.associate: Velvet has a name for every closed door.
presence_lines.made: Velvet smiles. The rope gives way.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Velvet has the house thanking her for entry.

members.rook_line: Velvet works the lounge. Private rooms still need public names.

presence_lines.marker: Bishop stands where the ceiling expects him.
presence_lines.associate: Bishop checks the shift without looking up.
presence_lines.made: Bishop knows which camera is being polite.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Bishop has the audit window memorized.

members.rook_line: Bishop stays near the Grand's cage. Don't make him break cover.

presence_lines.marker: Lucky looks ready to race the tide.
presence_lines.associate: Lucky has three stops and one good shortcut.
presence_lines.made: Lucky grins like the clock owes him time.
presence_lines.inner_circle: Lucky is already moving when the plan lands.

members.rook_line: Lucky works the beach when the stalls are up. Otherwise, follow the Numbers.
